world_axes: X forward, Y left, Z up; distances metres; joints URDF radians internally
assumptions: Both arm bases are on one cart, facing a subject in front. The subject is never between the arms.
Reference URDF joint zero/sign conventions have not been aligned with the saved servo calibration; preview angles cannot be sent to hardware.
Cart dimensions, base positions, lens/light mount offsets and their optical axes are editable placeholders, not physical measurements.
The last joint rotates the payload. Its physical cable-safe roll travel and optical-axis alignment are unmeasured; full 360-degree motion is not certified.
Servo calibration converts raw positions via q=(raw-mid)*360/4095. The default wrist 0..4095 range was assigned, not observed as unobstructed rotation.
This is kinematic previsualization. It does not model collision meshes, payload dynamics, vibration, cables, wheel traction, stopping distance, or localization.
Truck and arc paths require a cart drivetrain capable of realizing the path; lateral cart motion is an unverified assumption.
Clip durations are editable creative choices, not measured hardware speed limits or minimum feasible times.
